description: Erection of a two storey side and rear extensions with internal alterations following demolition of existing garage and store
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Planning statement, DHP/722FS, Fire safety statement 
Received: 23/10/2023
DHP/722P Sheet 1, DHP/722P Sheet 2
Received: 08/01/2024].

Condition : 4 - The first floor bathroom formed in the side elevation as shown on drawing number DHP/722P Sheet 2, of the hereby approved development shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Condition : 5 - The boundary treatment shall be erected in accordance DHP/722P Sheet 2 and this shall be retained permanently thereafter.
